scripts.docker:build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:DOCKER_BUILDKIT='0'; $env:COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD='0'; docker compose up -d --build app; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item Env:DOCKER_BUILDKIT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code"
scripts.docker:migrate:clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:RESET_SCHEMA_BEFORE_PLAIN_DUMP='true'; docker compose run --rm migrate; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item Env:RESET_SCHEMA_BEFORE_PLAIN_DUMP -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code"
scripts.docker:go-no-go: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:DB_PUBLISHED_PORT='15432'; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/predeploy-go-no-go.ps1 -EnsureUp -AppUrl 'http://localhost:18080/login.html'; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item Env:DB_PUBLISHED_PORT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code"
scripts.docker:go-no-go:strict: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:DB_PUBLISHED_PORT='15432'; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/predeploy-go-no-go.ps1 -EnsureUp -Strict -AppUrl 'http://localhost:18080/login.html'; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item Env:DB_PUBLISHED_PORT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code"
